Gold and Silver Prices Fluctuate Amid Global and Domestic Factors

Gold and silver prices have seen significant fluctuations, with some reports indicating a sharp decline and others noting a rise. These movements are influenced by global uncertainties, including US-Iran talks and international price trends, as well as domestic factors like the upcoming week's trading and consumer behavior towards selling old jewelry. Analysts are providing predictions and tracking key price levels amidst these varied market signals.
